title: My House
text:
My house is small and blue. It has two windows and a red door. There is a big tree in the garden. The tree is green and tall.

My room is upstairs. It has a small bed and a desk. The walls are white. I like my room because it is quiet.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about nature?
options: The writer probably does not like trees
The writer probably lives in a city apartment
The writer probably does not like the color blue

questions.text: What kind of place is the writer's room probably?

vocabulary.definition: high from the bottom to the top
on a higher floor of a building

paragraph_translations: Mi casa es pequeña y azul. Tiene dos ventanas y una puerta roja. Hay un árbol grande en el jardín. El árbol es verde y alto.
Mi habitación está arriba. Tiene una cama pequeña y un escritorio. Las paredes son blancas. Me gusta mi habitación porque es tranquila.
